apierror-jupyterlite-disabled: Shown when action=jupyterliteconfig is called while $wgJupyterLiteEnabled is false.
jupyterlite-portlet-open: Toolbox link that opens an empty sandbox. Keep it short - it sits in the sidebar.
jupyterlite-portlet-tooltip: Tooltip for the toolbox link. Says plainly that code there runs with the reader's own wiki rights.
jupyterlite-open-notebook: Tab on a File: page for a .ipynb, opening that notebook in the sandbox.
jupyterlite-notebook-missing: Shown when the file page exists but has no uploaded file behind it.
